notes: Facility types. Placeholder values for balancing. A propellant plant turns the named resource into propellant: output per day = peak_output_kg_per_day x availability of the resource on the body (see bodies.json) x conversion. A type with a 'kit' can be loaded onto a ship at a shipyard (costs cost_eur, takes mass_kg of the ship's payload) and deployed at a body from orbit.
